paper: step 8. Provisional Section 3.3. The commons reference evaluation model is a trained artifact.
adr: Training lives under tools/evaluator-training/. This file is the LoRA run: base, hyperparameters, framework pins, seed. The generation recipe is recipe.json. The held-out suite is not an input. The training base is Qwen3-1.7B: same Qwen family, tokenizer, and chat template as the measured 0.6B ceiling, only the parameter count moves. The live pin is unchanged. NOTE: this file is the within-family capacity A/B recipe and is not the recipe for the register-coverage re-sweep. That run is driven by sweep-recipe.json, which trains Qwen3-0.6B. Do not edit this file to change the sweep.

base.note: Read at run time from the manifest. repoId here is a pin that must match. This is the training base. The live evaluator pin stays baseRepoId/fileName (Qwen3-0.6B Q8_0 at v2.1) until a trained 1.7B passes the gate.

framework.whyNotUnsloth: 1.7B plus 3936 short examples on an 80GB card does not need Unsloth's memory path. The standard stack is the one a reader can follow without a third training runtime.
framework.reportToNote: No cloud metric sink. Loss logs to stdout and artifacts/train-log.json. Trackio would be a Hub side channel this run does not need.
framework.torch: supplied by the GPU image; not pinned here so a CUDA wheel is not overwritten

train.gradientCheckpointingNote: Recompute activations instead of storing them. Trainer sets use_reentrant false. The training model sets use_cache false so checkpointing does not conflict with KV cache. A 1.7B is far lighter than the abandoned 3B run, so per-device batch 2 / grad-accum 16 / seq 2048 stays.
train.enableThinkingNote: Qwen3 thinking must stay off. Inference uses QwenChatWrapper thoughts=discourage. Training applies enable_thinking=False so the assistant target is the compact verdict line, with the stock empty think block as prefix outside the mask. Do not set assistant_only_loss to false.
train.chatTemplateNote: Stock Qwen3 template plus {% generation %} around assistant content. TRL assistant_only_loss needs those spans. Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen3-1.7B share this template. Rendered text must match stock; train.py refuses to start if it does not, or if the assistant mask is empty, or if no-think is not active. The SmolLM3 template is not used for this run.
train.evalDatasetNote: The held-out suite is the final gate, never a training or hyperparameter split. Epochs are fixed. Loss is logged. There is no early stopping.

llamaCpp.note: convert_hf_to_gguf.py then llama-quantize Q8_0. The run records the resolved commit in artifacts.json. Q8_0 matches the live vendor pin's quantization.

time.estimate: Well under three hours on a single 80GB card. 1.7B LoRA, 3936 examples, 3 epochs, sequences around 2k tokens, then merge, llama.cpp convert, and 187 compact-verdict gate items. If a run is still training after 90 minutes, stop and report: that is a hang, not the expected duration.

publish.when: only after gate-report.json pass is true
publish.note: Publication writes a trainedCandidate on the model manifest. It does not replace the live v2.1 vendor GGUF and it does not change the default evaluator.
